examples.label: Product tour video with a poster frame
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-video" site="Global" id="video-product-tour" ratio="video" rounded="large" thumbnail="/images/card-1.jpg" controls preload="none">
  <:source src="https://mdn.github.io/shared-assets/videos/flower.webm" type="video/webm" />
  <:source src="https://mdn.github.io/shared-assets/videos/flower.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
</.component>

examples.label: Tutorial video with English captions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-video" site="Global" id="video-getting-started" ratio="video" rounded="medium" caption_size="small" caption_background="dark" controls>
  <:source src="https://mdn.github.io/shared-assets/videos/flower.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
  <:track label="English" kind="captions" srclang="en" src="data:text/vtt;base64," default={true} />
</.component>

examples.label: Muted looping clip behind a section heading
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-video" site="Global" id="video-hero-loop" ratio="video" rounded="extra_large" thumbnail="/images/card-2.jpg" autoplay muted loop playsinline>
  <:source src="https://mdn.github.io/shared-assets/videos/flower.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
</.component>
